scope: Explicit ReconAI API, durable-worker, reconciliation, and outbox OTLP/HTTP protobuf runtime contract

assertions.name: standard_signal_paths
assertions.evidence: The real exporters POSTed to /v1/traces and /v1/metrics only.

assertions.name: protobuf_transport
assertions.evidence: Both requests used application/x-protobuf and contained non-empty bodies.

assertions.name: explicit_resources_and_instruments
assertions.evidence: Captured bytes contained the fixed test service plus API, worker, reconciliation, and outbox instruments.

assertions.name: w3c_parent_extraction
assertions.evidence: A valid version-00 traceparent produced the expected active 32-hex trace ID.

assertions.name: untrusted_context_minimization
assertions.evidence: Caller-controlled tracestate is unsupported; invalid caller text supplied as method and traceparent was normalized/rejected and absent from captured bytes.

assertions.name: tenant_and_payload_sentinel_scan
assertions.evidence: Captured protobuf bytes did not contain organization-secret-value or customer-payload-value.

assertions.name: configuration_fail_closed
assertions.evidence: Production requires a fixed HTTPS collector origin; credentials, path, query, fragment, plaintext production transport, invalid sampling, and incompatible timeout/interval are rejected.

assertions.name: local_disabled_mode
assertions.evidence: An empty non-production endpoint returned a network-free no-op runtime.

assertions.name: bounded_runtime
assertions.evidence: Sampling, signal concurrency, trace queue/batch, span fields, metric cardinality/batch, export interval, and timeout have explicit ceilings.

assertions.name: reconciliation_aggregate_signals
assertions.evidence: Run outcome/duration and input/match/exception/ambiguous-candidate values exported with fixed labels and no organization or run identifier; replay wiring omits duplicate result totals.

assertions.name: outbox_aggregate_signals
assertions.evidence: Relay batch outcome/duration and published/retried/dead-lettered event values exported with fixed labels and no tenant, event, job, or payload identifier.

assertions.name: graceful_flush
assertions.evidence: forceFlush delivered both signals and shutdown closed both providers and the loopback server.

commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/observability/src/observability.test.ts packages/config/src/config.test.ts

commands.summary: format, lint, typecheck, 336 tests, migration/schema/config/edge/OIDC/container/dependency/license policies, and all builds
224 production packages matched the approved offline inventory

limitations: This is a local loopback exporter contract, not protected staging or production collector/backend evidence.
W3C context is not persisted through the outbox; worker consumer spans are separate traces correlated through logs.
Queue depth/age, connector freshness, webhook, review-age, and AI signals remain unimplemented.
Collector authentication, egress/TLS, backend access and retention, representative load/cardinality, outage/recovery, termination, dashboards, and external alerts remain unexercised.
claim: Local observability runtime and OTLP transport contract verified; no production-readiness, SLO, staging, or alert-delivery claim.
